translation: Gather on the tenth day of the tenth month, dry in the shade. (Yarrow-seed 蓍實 is its envoy; it is averse to hemp seed 大麻子.) Original text of the Benjing: Cassia seed (決明子), flavor salty, level. It chiefly treats green blindness (青盲), film over the eyes (淫膚), red and white membranes, and red painful tearing eyes.
